dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical geometric narrowing from the mid-dorsal region toward the visible posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light-grey to off-white median pixel intensity across the dorsal plane.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: High-frequency, diffuse grey mottling distributed across the entire visible dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient slopes between the lighter primary skin tone and darker mottled regions.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A distinct, high-contrast, crescent-shaped white linear mark is visible on the mid-dorsal plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent crescent-shaped white scar or marking is present on the upper-mid dorsal surface.
